summary: V6.9 testing — Timeline↔Codex bridge + Companion seats + scale-aware tokens. Backend 100% (7/7 V6.9 incl. 2 new extended tests with real 2nd user; 31/31 regression V6.6/6.7/6.8 still green). Critical battlemap companion-can-move-token-after-assign-and-403-after-revoke flow VERIFIED end-to-end against live backend. Frontend: timeline-panel renders on Atelier→Timeline subtab; all data-testid + helper-text present in source per grep. Codex chart view interactive flow could not be auto-driven because the Codex tab is rendered inside KNOWLEDGE WEB tab strip with text-button selectors (no `tab-codex` testid). All other surfaces verified.
critical_code_review_comments: Campaign-detail tab strip exposes only text labels (CHARACTERS/CHANNELS/KNOWLEDGE WEB/SESSIONS/DECKS/PLAYER PRIMER/ATELIER/DELTA DROP/CUSTOM RULES/INVITE & SHARE). Only `tab-atelier` + `tab-characters` have data-testids. Add `tab-knowledge`, `tab-sessions`, `tab-channels`, `tab-codex`, `tab-decks`, `tab-primer`, `tab-delta`, `tab-rules`, `tab-invite` for testability. Without them the codex/chart drilldown can only be reached via text-content selectors which is brittle.
Character cards use testid `character-{id}` (not `character-card-{id}` as in some other surfaces). Inconsistent naming — would prefer the `*-card-` prefix seen elsewhere.
timeline_markers.py is well-bounded (~115 lines) — no concerns. Validation of `session_id` and `codex_node_id` belonging to the campaign is solid (returns 400 if mismatched).

characters.py companion endpoints use query-param `player_id` (consistent with /transfer). Note that revoke does NOT 404 if player_id was never a companion — DELETE is idempotent which is fine, but consider returning a 404/no-op flag if visibility into accidental no-ops is desired.

Battlemap upsert_token correctly added the `companion_owners` check (lines 180-188). The companion player is NOT auto-added as a member of the campaign — if GM assigns a companion to someone outside the table, that user still gets 403 from `_is_member` at line 165 before reaching the companion check. This is fine (defence-in-depth) but worth documenting: companions must already be seated.
Carry V6.7→V6.9: CharacterSheet.jsx ownership gate using non-existent localStorage key `tg_user_id` (forge-power-bundles) — still unresolved, not in V6.9 scope but tracked.
PRD-deferred refactor of CharacterSheet/CampaignDetail/ReferenceEditor (4052 lines across 3 files) acknowledged. Recommend prioritising next sprint.
